artefacts.title: The manual case before the machine
artefacts.payload: Aleksandar has been finding sellers manually — sending cold emails one by one with a short, blunt message: "Want to sell your business?" It works. He gets a 4% reply rate… But it doesn't scale. He can send maybe a dozen emails a day by hand.
artefacts.caption_fact: The outbound engine started by documenting one founder's hand-sent emails (a dozen a day, 4% replies) before any automation was scoped.
artefacts.why_it_fits: The headline is 'follow one real case first'; this PRD paragraph is literally that case.

artefacts.title: Kill switch read before step one
artefacts.payload:
kill = env.get("KILL_SWITCH", "0").strip()
if kill == "1":
    msg = "KILL_SWITCH=1 in env — halting run.py immediately. No sub-steps executed."
    log.error(msg)
    print(msg)
    return 2
artefacts.caption_fact: The daily orchestrator checks a kill switch before any source/enrich/send step runs.
artefacts.why_it_fits: Shadowing the handoffs surfaced the need for a stop point before the happy path even starts.

artefacts.payload:
# Defensive extraction: some providers (notably GLM via OR on long

artefacts.title: Dedup key is identity, not state
artefacts.payload:
def dedup_key(record: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Stable key for KV / SQLite dedup. Provider + type + id.

    Never include the watermark — a record's identity does not change when its
    fields do. The watermark drives incremental sync; the dedup_key drives
    'have I already seen this?'.
    """
    prov = record.get("_provider") or "unknown"
    rtype = record.get("record_type") or "unknown"
    rid = record.get("internal_id") or "missing"
    return f"{prov}:{rtype}:{rid}"
artefacts.caption_fact: The CRM sync keys every record as provider:type:id so a re-run updates instead of duplicating.
artefacts.why_it_fits: Closing the loop means the record is updated, not copied in twice by a human.

artefacts.title: Regex before any token is spent
artefacts.payload:
RE_OPENING_FLUFF = re.compile(
    r"^(Certainly!?|Absolutely!?|Great question!?|Sure!|Of course!?|"
…
RE_EM_DASH = re.compile(r"\s*[—–]\s*")
…
    "delve", "leverage", "robust", "comprehensive", "key takeaways",
artefacts.caption_fact: The humanizer strips AI-tell phrases with regex in a deterministic pre-pass; the model only sees what rules could not fix.
artefacts.why_it_fits: A rule handled the obvious cases; no agent needed.

artefacts.title: Fail open, retry once, never raise
artefacts.payload:
"""Ask Jev every question in `questions` about `state` in ONE request.

HTTP 429 sleeps min(retry-after or 1 s, 5 s) and retries once.
Fails open: any exception, HTTP error or malformed body returns a JevResult with
`error` set and empty answers. Never raises.
"""
artefacts.caption_fact: The decision-model client retries once on rate limit and otherwise fails open with an error field rather than raising.
artefacts.why_it_fits: 'An API call and one human check' is enough when the client degrades predictably.

artefacts.title: Route by confidence: agent, human, skip
artefacts.caption_fact: Email triage sends anything under 0.6 confidence, or any error, to a human instead of the agent.
artefacts.why_it_fits: The decision test in nine lines: rule → gate → agent, with the human as the default.

artefacts.title: Handoff means no tools
artefacts.payload: **HANDOFF MEANS NO TOOLS.** When the caller says "operator", "human", "speak to someone", or you transfer for any reason (emergency, English-only mismatch, hostile caller, repeated unclear audio after 2 spell-back tries, tool failure), your response is **ONLY the transfer line**. Do **NOT** call `list_slots`. Do **NOT** call `book_slot`.
artefacts.figure: 2 spell-back tries; 2 slot attempts max before transfer
artefacts.caption_fact: The dental voice agent's prompt names six transfer reasons and forbids any tool call once the transfer line is spoken.
artefacts.why_it_fits: Knowing when to stop talking is written as a hard rule, not a fallback.

artefacts.title: Escape word in the first sentence
artefacts.payload:
"Hi, you've reached {CLINIC_NAME}. I'm Lisa, your assistant. "
"This call is handled by an AI. If you'd rather speak to a human, just say \"operator\" at any time. "

artefacts.title: Retry, then raise to an owner
artefacts.caption_fact: The LLM client retries rate limits and 5xx errors twice with backoff, then raises so a human sees it.

artefacts.title: Kill switch: engage pauses, release does not resume
artefacts.payload: description: One-shot kill switch. --engage sets KILL_SWITCH=1 in the workspace .env and calls instantly_client.py --action pause. --release sets KILL_SWITCH=0 but does NOT auto-resume Instantly (operator must resume in UI + verify canary green).
artefacts.caption_fact: Releasing the kill switch does not resume sending; a human must resume and confirm the canary is green.
artefacts.why_it_fits: Audit trail plus a named human step between exception and restart.

artefacts.title: Loop aborts when the same finding repeats
artefacts.payload:
def finding_fingerprint(f: Finding) -> str:
    """Return a stable 16-hex-char hash of (severity, file, summary).

    Used by the loop to detect oscillation: if the same fingerprint appears
    in three consecutive rounds without being fixed, the loop aborts.
    """
artefacts.caption_fact: anneal fingerprints every finding and aborts its fix loop if one repeats for three rounds, handing control back to a person.
artefacts.why_it_fits: The model is uncertain → the script stops and an owner decides.
